_about: Public-domain Augustine Baker (1575-1641, English Benedictine) for the Word Hoard: Holy Wisdom, or Directions for the Prayer of Contemplation, digested by Serenus Cressy and edited by Abbot Sweeney (London: Burns & Oates, 1911), the first printing as Sancta Sophia (Douay, 1657), and his Confessions, edited by Justin McCann (London, 1922), from Internet Archive scans. Written in English, so no translator applies. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 25 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

baker-holy-wisdom-1911: Holy Wisdom, or Directions for the Prayer of Contemplation, digested by Serenus Cressy, ed. Abbot Sweeney (London: Burns & Oates, 1911)
baker-sancta-sophia-1657: Sancta Sophia, or Directions for the Prayer of Contemplation, digested by Serenus Cressy (Doway: John Patte and Thomas Fievet, M.DC.LVII)
baker-confessions-mccann: The Confessions of Venerable Father Augustine Baker, ed. Justin McCann (London: Washbourne, 1922)

_alternates.baker-holy-wisdom-copies: Another 1911 copy and an undated Burns and Oates, Ltd. copy
_alternates.baker-holy-practises: The Holy Practises of a Devine Lover (Paris, 1657): its title page names no author
_alternates.baker-gertrude-more: The Inner Life of Dame Gertrude More (Washbourne, about 1910): the title page does not name Baker

_excluded.baker-ccel: CCEL baker/holy_wisdom (undated Burns Oates & Washbourne) and baker/more (1937)

baker-sancta-sophia-1657.author: title page read: 'written by the late Ven. Father F. AVGYSTIN BAKER, A Monke of the English Congregation' (OCR 'AVGYSTIN', long-s OCR)

_pending.baker-holy-wisdom-1876: A dated copy of the first Sweeney edition (1876): not found
